attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "Changes many core DI extension methods to use TryAddEnumerable for idempotency, which is broadly safe but touches widely-used registration points (display drivers, migrations, permissions, recipes) across the framework, so any subtle behavior change (e.g., relying on duplicate registrations or exact ordering) could affect downstream modules."}

reason: Changes many core DI extension methods to use TryAddEnumerable for idempotency, which is broadly safe but touches widely-used registration points (display drivers, migrations, permissions, recipes) across the framework, so any subtle behavior change (e.g., relying on duplicate registrations or exact ordering) could affect downstream modules.
